name: transitland-id-crosswalks
title: Transitland ID crosswalks
description: Crosswalks between Transitland Onestop IDs and the identifiers the same operators and feeds carry in other transit data systems. Built from the tags on the DMFR records in this repository.

resources.name: us-ntd
resources.description: Transitland Onestop IDs crosswalked to `us_ntd_id` values tagged on operator records.

fields.name: external_id
fields.description: The identifier this record carries in the external system.

fields.name: onestop_id
fields.description: The Transitland operator or feed the identifier belongs to.

fields.name: entity
fields.description: Which kind of Transitland record carries the tag.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Operator name, for readability. Not an identifier.

fields.name: related
fields.description: Onestop IDs on the other side of the association, semicolon separated: a tagged operator's feeds, or a tagged feed's operators.
